description.narrative: The International Development Association (IDA) is an international financial institution which offers concessional loans and grants to the world's poorest developing countries. The IDA is a member of the World Bank Group and complements the existing the existing International Bank for Reconstruction and Development by lending to developing countries which suffer from the lowest gross national income, from troubled creditworthiness, or from the lowest per capita income. IDA18 presents a paradigm shift in how it mobilizes finance to help IDA clients achieve their development goals. Funding under this initiative represents a core grant payment Australia's contribution to IDA18. The total value of this initiative is $130.2 million covering the period 2017-2026.
